collection_method: Specific public live sites and gallery detail pages inspected via web text; gallery labels are metadata only, not direct desktop/mobile screenshot verification.

references.name: PHASE ONE 名古屋新栄
references.text_confirmed: The salon site shows separate Concept, Menu, Treatment, Gallery, Access and Reserve links and feature sections about its interior and service.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Separate an expressive salon story from a readable appointment menu; propose how to balance service prices with atmospheric photography.

references.name: cafe MELS 名古屋
references.text_confirmed: The cafe site divides meals and desserts into named categories and includes takeout, shop information and featured dish introductions.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Make a menu of many products navigable while retaining a prominent flagship dish and store details.

references.name: 味処 風雅 名古屋
references.text_confirmed: A local Japanese restaurant site publishes about, menu, gallery and access navigation together with real food images and seasonal meal text.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Develop a shop-specific story and food-led sections while leaving hours, access and contact easily findable.

references.name: DINING BAR Torta due 名古屋

references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Organize different offerings and atmospheres without repeating generic equal-sized product cards.

references.name: お食事の店 おぐら 長久手
references.text_confirmed: The restaurant site features chef-selected seasonal ingredients, signature sashimi, seats, a gallery and reservation navigation.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Create a coherent rhythm from signature food to seating and booking without inventing historical claims.

references.name: period 名古屋プライベートサロン
references.text_confirmed: The salon site clearly divides menu, price plans, shop information and FAQ, and links booking through messages.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: For a service business, put pricing, trust details and consultation flow before empty luxury decoration.

references.name: 日之出整骨院 福井
references.text_confirmed: The clinic homepage offers treatment information, sports nutrition, athlete voices, FAQ, blog and contact details.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Compare trust-building factual navigation with the emotional atmosphere of a health-service homepage.

references.name: NELU 高麗橋
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists the NELU restaurant site and credits its maker, tagging image impact, silver-black tones, type, lines and motion.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Explore how editorial restaurant identity can balance dark photography and fine type without copying its motion.

references.name: peace put
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU identifies the peace put company site, its creative partners, and image, typography, beige-brown palette and motion tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Take only transferable visual hierarchy between food photography and restrained supporting brand words.

references.name: Cartapani
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists Cartapani and marks typography, gold-green-brown palette, special web fonts and responsive design.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Study how muted premium colours can complement food instead of competing with its natural tones.

references.name: 日本料理店 宝善亭
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU identifies the Japanese restaurant and credits its design team; the gallery tags grey, grid and horizontal scrolling.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Test a calm Japanese page hierarchy with a clearly readable factual section, without assuming gallery tags prove live behaviour.

references.name: SOLES GAUFRETTE
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists this sweets site with typographic polish, texture, muted purple-blue palette and image-heavy branding tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Explore a sweets identity that is distinctive without using predictable cream-and-red wagashi styling.

references.name: HAIR ICI
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists HAIR ICI with natural atmosphere, white ground, video and rule-based layout tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Assess whether subtle lines and rich salon imagery help the shop feel human rather than generic.

references.name: SPA NOIR
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU tags SPA NOIR as elegant, beige-brown, typography and photo-focused, with a single-page and grid label.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Investigate a premium wellness mood that still leaves service explanations and accessibility clear.

references.name: SEE/SAW
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU cites the SEE/SAW hair-care brand site and a named design team, tagging restrained black-white-purple colours and motion.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Consider product texture and premium hair-care photography while keeping product facts distinct from decoration.

references.name: NANEA HAIR
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists NANEA HAIR with green, blue and white branding, fine lines, natural atmosphere and responsive tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Contrast this relaxed salon palette with stronger service and booking hierarchy across screen sizes.

references.name: Cellato
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists Cellato as a premium food/ecommerce site with Japanese vertical writing, dark palette and horizontal movement tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Review which vertical-typography principles are feasible without depending on complex movement or copied compositions.

references.name: MAISON CACAO
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU indexes the chocolate brand with refined typography, restrained white ground and large impact food images.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Compare premium product photography and quiet whitespace against the weak one-inset v3 section.

references.name: BLUE YARD
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists BLUE YARD with blue accents, grid/card layout, rule-based detail, typography and responsive tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Study how a distinctive theme colour and grid can guide product browsing without making every card identical.

references.name: SWISS洋菓子店
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists the confectionery brand with soft warm yellows, rounded corners, an elegant look and responsive tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Test a friendly premium pastry tone rather than assuming every premium sweets brand needs black ink.

references.name: Kariomons Coffee Roaster
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists a coffee-roaster brand with split-screen, distinctive accent colours, gradients and photo-heavy imagery tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Compare expressive two-part hero scenes while considering whether food/product details remain readable.

references.name: hōsa
references.text_confirmed: MUUUUU lists the restaurant brand with vertical type, monochrome/cream shades, fine lines, grid and page-transition tags.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Extract calm Japanese editorial page rhythm without copying motion or confusing ornamental vertical text with facts.

references.name: Karaoke Bar BLOOD 藤が丘
references.text_confirmed: The local bar site has a story, drink offering, gallery and access information; its blog still shows sample Hello world posts.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Use a real local example to study how unfinished filler harms brand trust, even when visual identity is intended to be upscale.

references.name: 美・れい 藤が丘
references.text_confirmed: The local lounge homepage groups its introduction, drinks menu, access and atmosphere; the menu is visibly extensive.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Plan readable category navigation and honest store-personality content instead of relying solely on image-driven hero.

references.name: 重原整骨院・整体院 旭川
references.text_confirmed: The clinic site organizes many symptom categories, multiple locations, reception information and appointment paths.
references.technique_hypothesis_unreviewed: Investigate reducing an overlong category navigation to clear consultation/appointment steps without introducing new medical claims.
